propositions: 23 sites in test_concurrency_regression.py use _expire_sync_marker paired with _engine_run(..., 'list') to establish fixture preconditions via incidental side effects, but ensure_fresh swallows failures silently under CI load causing flaky setup failures
8 of the 23 sites are load-bearing preconditions (Kind P) where one clone must synchronize from the other deterministically before the test assertion can execute
15 of the 23 sites are behavior-under-test (Kind R) where the read-side reconvergence through the production path IS the invariant the test exists to prove, not a setup mechanism

Converting Kind P sites to deterministic _sync_from_origin (checked git fetch + ff-only merge) eliminates the flake surface while preserving Kind R sites on _engine_run to avoid deleting the invariant they measure
Tests pass under both default env and REBAR_SYNC_PULL=off after converting preconditions, proving the deterministic path lands even when best-effort sync is disabled
